cu_thuy_bach.add: She made the boy Hoàn Cô Bách sleep on stone through three winters, and let the fever take two of his year-mates because the rule said to harden them.

diem_hai_tao.add: The port house takes a tenth of every smuggler's cargo that lands under its lamp, and she calls it a lamp fee.

kien_vien_chi.add: He has copied the sewing ledger and tells Thiệu Thanh Đài he has not.

tat_hanh_vu.wants: To hear the Haze Walk's ninth layer read correctly by someone other than himself before he dies.
tat_hanh_vu.secret: He is teaching the ninth layer in pieces to his granddaughter Tất Quế Lạc, folded into her chalk drills, and has told the Array Hall it is only a game.

khong_duong_quy.wants: A shed of Bách Thảo Viện rebuilt, with its books under one roof.
khong_duong_quy.secret: She replants the academy's lost herbs in rows across Quyền Thanh Lam's fields, among what he takes for weeds, and he has begun to plough around them without a word.

nhac_chinh_hanh.wants: A sect where no exception is left to renew.
nhac_chinh_hanh.secret: Every decade he signs the Hall's exception for Quản Ảnh Hồ without reading it, the one rule he bends, because he cannot bring himself to ask what her mirror method does.

lo_da_huong.wants: A pup in her line that finds a ginseng a thousand years old.
lo_da_huong.secret: She sells Hồng Lô Cốc pups she has quietly spayed, so that no vassal ever breeds its own silver marten line.
lo_da_huong.add: Every pup she sells to the vassal will never breed.

bien_van_tinh.wants: A peace so long that her letters are the only thing crossing the border.
bien_van_tinh.secret: She tells Hồ Tùng Nguyệt the dates of the warden's winter drills so that Tùng Đào's patrols stay off the ice, and calls it keeping the peace.
bien_van_tinh.add: She tells Tùng Đào when the warden drills, and calls it courtesy.

la_trac_thach.wants: A jade seam without a flaw, and one seal cut from it that he would never sell.
la_trac_thach.secret: He is slipping jade pill needles, which bend, in among the steel ones to see whether the Furnace Hall notices; Úy Thanh Diễm tastes every batch and has so far said nothing.

du_tuc_doan.wants: A Green Door Day every day of the month.
du_tuc_doan.secret: He fills the poor's satchels on the Green Door Day with the Furnace Hall's wound pills from his own stock, and Tề Tử Tô has begun to count the shortfall in her batches.

pham_thu_dien.wants: To see one Earth-only outer disciple pass the inner gate in his lifetime.
pham_thu_dien.secret: He has marked two Earth disciples a half-grade up in the gate ledger so that they may sit the inner test; if the Hall of Rules audits the ledger it will find his hand.
pham_thu_dien.add: He marks the disciples he likes a half-grade up in the gate ledger.

quyen_tieu_mach.wants: Kết Đan before her father dies, or the courage to stop trying.
quyen_tieu_mach.secret: She was told to burn the seed of the sect's first rice when it failed; instead she plants a single row of it each spring in her mother's herb garden.

bao_nham_tinh.wants: To be buried among the life trees he waters.
bao_nham_tinh.secret: He grafts cuttings from dead disciples' life trees onto living ones so that no one he walks down the mountain to tell will lose a tree; the Hall of Rules would call it fraud of the roll.

quan_anh_ho.wants: To die by water, still at Trúc Cơ, with the mirror method taught to one person.
quan_anh_ho.secret: She is teaching the still-water method to the servant girl who fetches her water, against the exception that forbids her to teach it; the Hall renews the exception next year.

uong_muc_dich.wants: Kết Đan in spring with the herd listening, or a quiet place under the cattle's tree.
uong_muc_dich.secret: He has taught the lead cow to bow to one tune and charges the Mục Ca herders a copper to watch.
uong_muc_dich.add: He charges the Mục Ca herders a copper to watch the lead cow bow to his tune.

tham_tinh_sa.wants: A clan hall in Bạch Sa with his name on the lintel, paid for with clean books.
tham_tinh_sa.secret: He keeps a second set of the port house's books in which every pill price is two parts in a hundred high, and sends the difference home to the Thẩm clan; Diêm Hải Tảo has trusted his sums for thirty years.
tham_tinh_sa.add: He skims two parts in a hundred from every pill price and sends it to the clan.

te_tu_to.wants: To finish reading the Rotting Canopy Canon before the sealed shelf is found open.
te_tu_to.secret: She is copying the forbidden canon into her wound-pill recipes a line at a time, and one batch in forty carries a trace of it; Dư Tục Đoạn's patients are drinking it.
te_tu_to.add: One batch in forty of her wound pills carries a trace of the forbidden canon, and she does not tell the patients.

au_duong_tan_di.wants: To go down to the new seat and grow magnolias like any other disciple.
au_duong_tan_di.secret: One night a month she walks down the mountain to the new seat and back before dawn, and Bành Lập Mai lies in her bed to cover for her.
au_duong_tan_di.add: She tells Cù Thúy Bách she sleeps early, and slips down the mountain.

me_dien_nhi.wants: A plot the sect will count as its own.
me_dien_nhi.secret: She sells a stalk a month of the fourth plot's three spirit grasses to a Thạch Kiều Thành broker to pay off her father's debts; Phạm Thủ Điền has not asked where the coin comes from.

phu_lien_kieu.wants: To go home a hero of the pines with the canon's list complete, and to find a reason to stay.
phu_lien_kieu.secret: He has begun to forge the lists he sends Hồ Tùng Nguyệt, because the shelves are open and nothing is worth stealing; the false pages are filled with names of Cold Ford children he has grown fond of.
